title: Untitled (Snowmen, Planes, Pawns)
description: Mixed-media collage combining drawn snowman figures, top-down and side-view warplane silhouettes, concentric target rings, and compact discs across a white ground. Two chess pawns — one light wood, one black — anchor the lower register alongside an American football and a row of iridescent CDs.
composition: Tiered horizontal registers, top to bottom
